title: Google's AI told people to put glue on pizza

beats.say: Google's AI once told people to put glue on their pizza.
In 2024, someone asked Google why the cheese slides off their pizza.

beats.sub: of non-toxic glue, into the sauce
beats.say: Its new AI answer: mix about one eighth of a cup of non-toxic glue into the sauce.
It came from a joke Reddit comment. Eleven years old. Almost word for word.
Then people asked how many rocks they should eat. It answered that too.

beats.sub: almost nobody had searched it before
beats.say: Google says that came from a satire site. Almost nobody had searched it before.

beats.big:
AI can't
tell a joke
from a fact.
beats.say: The AI couldn't tell a joke from a fact. Google later cut back on forum posts in its answers.
